FAQs

What is Impact-Driven Innovation?

Impact-Driven Innovation is an approach that aligns every stage of the innovation funnel with measurable business outcomes.

Unlike programs that only chase impact at the end, this method builds impact into the entire process—from identifying challenges and scouting technologies to managing ideas and tracking results.

By focusing on strategic alignment and ROI from the start, organizations can scale innovation efforts that truly move the needle.

What sets Qmarkets apart from other innovation software?

While many platforms focus only on gathering ideas, we offer a comprehensive suite designed to manage every stage of the innovation funnel – from strategic challenge definition to implementation and ROI tracking.

Our approach combines:

Enterprise-Grade Flexibility – A modular, highly customizable platform that adapts to your goals and workflows.

AI-Powered Features – Intelligent automation and evaluation tools that enhance decision-making and scalability.

Proven Methodologies – Built-in best practices shaped by nearly two decades of real-world experience.

Unmatched Customer Support – Expert guidance and a dedicated success team to help you drive measurable results.

Qmarkets helps you build a structured, results-focused innovation program, tailored to your business and built to scale.

Who is Qmarkets for?

Qmarkets is built for large and mid-sized organizations looking to manage innovation in a structured, scalable, and results-focused way.

We serve companies across all industries and sectors — including manufacturing, finance, healthcare, energy, retail, technology, and the public sector. Our flexible platform adapts to your unique challenges, no matter your field.

Qmarkets supports a wide range of teams involved in innovation, including:

  • Innovation & Strategy teams
  • R&D departments
  • Digital transformation leaders
  • IT & technology scouting units
  • Process improvement teams
  • HR and employee engagement functions

Whether you’re running company-wide challenges, scouting emerging technologies, or optimizing your innovation portfolio, Qmarkets gives you the tools to drive measurable outcomes from start to finish.

How much does Qmarkets cost?

Qmarkets offers flexible pricing based on the size of your organization, the scope of your program, and the features you need. Plans are structured around an annual license, with the option for on-premise deployment if required.

Whether you’re starting with a single use case or managing an enterprise-wide innovation funnel, we’ll tailor your package to match your goals. Support from our customer success team is always included, and optional features like AI capabilities and integrations can be added as needed.

Visit our pricing page to explore the available packages and find the best fit for your organization.

How do I get started?

Getting started with Qmarkets is simple. Just reach out via our contact form or book a demo to connect with a member of our team.

From there, our Customer Success experts will help you assess your needs and build a tailored business case to align your innovation goals with strategic priorities. We’ll guide you through each step to ensure a smooth and successful launch.
